description: Establish cross-account VPC peering for shared infrastructure between 3 AWS accounts (prod, staging, shared-services). Must: create VPC peering connections between each account pair, update route tables in all VPCs to enable traffic flow, configure security groups to allow only required ports, verify connectivity between accounts, set up Network Address Translation (NAT) for egress, and document the network topology. Risk factors: route table misconfiguration causing traffic blackholes, security group too permissive, DNS resolution failing across accounts, peering connection limits exceeded. Tools available: terraform, aws CLI, ansible, CloudFormation.
